📌 Bitcoin price stalls near $82K as key resistance holds 

🌐 Bitcoin price pulled back after briefly breaking above $82,000 on Sept. 4, as traders took profits following a short squeeze driven by softer Federal Reserve expectations and renewed demand for US spot Bitcoin ETFs. According to data from cryptonews, Bitcoin price traded near $81,150 at the time of writing, having failed to hold an intraday move above the $82,000 psychological level. The pullback left the asset about 1% below its local high but still well above the $80,000 mark reclaimed during the previous session. 

⚠️ The rally accelerated after Bitcoin moved out of a range around $77,000–$79,000. Short sellers were forced to close leveraged positions as the price crossed $80,000, adding automatic buy orders to the market. CoinGlass data cited by market reports showed that the broader crypto market recorded more than $500 million in liquidations during the rally, with short positions accounting for most of the total. Bitcoin shorts reportedly absorbed about $415 million of those losses.

📊 Price action has since slowed near a technically important area. Galaxy Research data shared by analyst Quinten François placed Bitcoin’s 50-week moving average near $81,041, almost level with the current market price. According to François, Bitcoin has not closed a weekly candle above that moving average since November 2025. He said a move through $82,800 would also produce the first higher high of the broader downtrend and bring $90,000 back into consideration.

📌 HOW WITHDRAWALS WORK IN METATRONICS

There are two separate steps when withdrawing funds from AI Trading.
This is important to understand:

1. Exit funds from trading
2. Withdraw funds to an external wallet

These are not the same process.

Step 1: Exit from Trading Wallet

When you activate AI Trading, your funds are allocated to the Trading Wallet and participate in trading operations.

To return these funds from trading, open your Trading Wallet and select Request Withdrawal.

You will then choose a trading exit option.

The faster you want to exit trading, the higher the commission:

• Fastest exit: 10%
• 2 days: 5%
• 4 days: 3%
• 6 days: 2%
• 10 days: 0%

Once this process is completed, the funds return from the Trading Wallet to your available balance.

Step 2: Withdraw to your external wallet

After the funds become available for withdrawal, you can submit a separate request to send them to your external crypto wallet.

This withdrawal can take up to 24 hours to process.

The full process looks like this:

Trading Wallet → Trading Exit → Available Balance → Withdrawal Request → External Wallet

⚠️ Important

The fastest trading exit option does not mean that funds are instantly transferred to your external wallet.

It means that you choose the fastest available way to remove funds from the trading process.

The transfer to your external wallet is a separate step and may take up to 24 hours.

METATRONICS does not offer guaranteed instant withdrawals.

Even the fastest available trading exit option requires processing time and is not guaranteed to be immediate.
